pride_data.title: Development of a proximity labeling vector to identify protein-protein interactions in human stem cells
pride_data.projectDescription: Development a novel system employing TurboID-fusion proteins within an integrative and inducible expression vector to investigate the interactome during stem cell differentiation. Cells expressing U2AF2 (iU2) or GFP (iGFP) fused with TurboID in undifferentiated (D0) or mesoderm differentiated (D1) were analyzed to identified the interactome and detect changes under differentiation process.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: hiPSC expressing U2AF2(65kDa) or GFP fused with TurboID-HA were lysed with lysis buffer (50mM Tris pH 7.4; 150mM NaCl; 1% SDS;) with protease inhibitor (Sigma-Aldrich - S8830). The biotinylated proteins were purified using streptavidin-beads (Promega - V782A) following the manufacturer instructions. The purified proteins were identified by LC-MS/MS.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: Peptide identification was performed using MaxQuant software (version 2.2.0.0). Minimum peptide length was set at 7 amino acids. FDR was used Modifications included in proteins quantification was: Oxidation (M); Acetyl (Protein N-term). The peptides were search against human proteome (Database: UniProt - UP000005640/81837entries). LFQ intensity values was used to interactome analysis.
